summary.text: LANDHEIM BYGG AS (997 066 065), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2011-06-13; address Skramstadgården, Kvennomslinna 5, 2848 SKREIA, Norge. Main industry is Construction of residential and non-residential buildings (41.000); 12 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Anders Laeskogen; Board chair: Anders Laeskogen; Auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 14.77 m, operating profit NOK 134.61 k, net profit NOK 37.84 k, equity NOK 823.75 k, total assets NOK 3.44 m. Official website https://www.landheimbygg.no is verified (the registry lists it and the site shows the registered name).
